y = np.array([-6, -3, -2, -1, -1, -1, -1, -1, -1, -1])

# Check for differences
diffs = np.diff(y)
print(f"Differences: {diffs}")

# Check if it becomes constant
if all(val == y[-1] for val in y[3:]):
    print(f"Sequence is constant -1 from index 4 onwards.")

# Try to fit a polynomial of degree up to 5
for deg in range(1, 6):
    poly = np.polyfit(x, y, deg)
    p = np.poly1d(poly)
    if np.allclose(p(x), y, atol=1e-2):
        print(f"Polynomial of degree {deg} fits.")
        print(f"Next term: {p(len(y) + 1)}")
        break
else:
    print("No simple polynomial fits.")"}
